answer: VRF seeds, not extra names, gate entry. At the admission inlet a joiner parks 1,980 POA yield-free for 21 epochs and files one onyx, a VRF public key bound to its payer; a second filing is refused. Each epoch the private kernel — the seed only that process holds — has 40s to prove the epoch nonce. Late, copied, or same-payer proofs burn 540 POA and bench the key 18 epochs. One agent idles 1,980 POA; 700 fakes need 1.386 million POA and 700 kernels, vs ~145 POA. Weakness: seed rental; stamp first-proof timing on the onyx and slash shared-payer or identical-proof keys.
